note: Réunion keeps the overseas departments' list; Mozambicans and South Africans also stay 90 days in 180 without a visa. Chinese and Indians on trips organised by an approved agency (15 days), and Chinese, Indian and Russian nationals coming from Mauritius or Seychelles (a free 15-day visa on arrival), aren't modelled. Légifrance answers this client with a bot challenge, so the orders are read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policies of Overseas France
sources.said: For Réunion: China India Mozambique South Africa Nationals of China, India and Russia traveling from Mauritius or Seychelles to Réunion may obtain a free visa on arrival for a stay of up to 15 days.
